//Clock: THE DAYLIGHT HOUR-OF-DAY CLOCK: hw_clock_noon.json (whose comment explains the mechanism at length) with StartingHour 9 and EndingHour 18. A hidden 0 to 1 stat with BaseValue 0, no rate and ONE TimeOfDayMods entry adding +1 while the game hour is from StartingHour up to but NOT including EndingHour (.decomp/StatTimeOfDayModifier.cs IsInRange), so it reads 1 from 09:00 to 17:45 and 0 the rest of the day. The entry has NO requirements (a TimeOfDayMods entry that names a required stat is skipped when that stat does not resolve, which fails open); it is read only as a StatChangeTrigger entry {1,1} by Tgr_HW_Adder, so the adder never strikes at night. The hours 9 to 18 are a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER, session-inferred and unmeasured against play (adders are sun-seekers). INFERRED, harness probe: the same as the noon clock's, that a non-empty TimeOfDayMods array survives the framework load, read as hw_clock_daylight 1 at 09:00 and 0 at 18:00.

Description.DefaultText: Hidden clock: 1 from 09:00 to 18:00 and 0 the rest of the day. The Adder only strikes while it reads 1.
